description: Job Description: Production Engineer – CT/PT Transformer Industry Job Title: Production Engineer Industry: CT/PT Instrument Transformer Manufacturing Department: Production Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering Experience: 0–10 Years Job Location: Tushar Trans Equipment Pvt Ltd Employment Type: Full-Time Job Summary We are looking for Production Engineers to manage and monitor the manufacturing processes of Current Transformers (CTs) and Potential Transformers (PTs). Candidates should have a basic understanding of production activities, good coordination skills, and knowledge of basic ERP data entry. Freshers and experienced candidates with Electrical or Mechanical Engineering qualifications are welcome to apply. Key Responsibilities Monitor daily production activities according to the production plan and schedule. Coordinate CT/PT manufacturing processes, including winding, core assembly, insulation, assembly, and other activities as applicable. Ensure timely completion of production orders and achievement of production targets. Maintain daily production reports, job cards, work orders, and manufacturing records. Perform basic ERP entries related to production orders, material consumption, production output, and job status. Coordinate with the stores department for raw material availability and material issuance. Work closely with the quality and testing departments to resolve production-related issues. Monitor material utilization, production rejection, and wastage. Ensure proper utilization of manpower, machinery, tools, and equipment. Identify production delays and take necessary corrective actions in coordination with the concerned departments. Maintain proper documentation and ensure adherence to company procedures. Follow workplace safety rules, 5S practices, and quality standards. Coordinate with planning, purchase, stores, testing, quality, and dispatch departments. Educational Qualifications B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Required Skills Basic knowledge of CT/PT transformer manufacturing processes. Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and MS Office. Basic knowledge of ERP software and data entry. Ability to maintain production records and prepare daily reports. Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of manufacturing processes, material management, and production planning is an advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of daily and monthly production targets. Timely completion of manufacturing orders. Accuracy of ERP entries and production documentation. Reduction in material wastage and production rejection. Efficient utilization of manpower and materials. Compliance with quality, safety, and manufacturing standards.

title: SDE III - Backend
description: We're looking for an experienced SDE III - Backend who is strong in backend engineering, system design, and databases. The role is highly hands-on and involves designing and building scalable backend services, APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven workflows. Go is a key requirement for this role. Candidates coming from a strong Java backend background can also be considered, provided they have at least 1 year of hands-on Golang experience and are comfortable working primarily in Go. The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Backend Engineering: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Golang. Build and maintain reliable microservices and REST/GraphQL APIs. Design and implement event-driven systems and asynchronous processing using queues/messaging systems. Build backend systems capable of handling high-volume and transaction-heavy workloads. Work on performance, scalability, reliability, security, and availability of backend services. Diagnose and resolve production issues and performance bottlenecks. System Design: Own technical solutions from design through implementation and production. Design scalable distributed systems and define appropriate service boundaries. Make sound decisions around databases, APIs, caching, messaging, and system architecture. Participate in architecture and design discussions and contribute to technical documentation. Databases: Work extensively with relational and NoSQL databases. Design efficient schemas, queries, indexes, and data access patterns. Understand database scalability, performance optimization, consistency, and reliability. Engineering and Collaboration: Write clean, maintainable, production-quality code. Develop unit, integration, and performance tests. Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. Collaborate with frontend/mobile engineers and infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end product functionality. Contribute to CI/CD, observability, monitoring, and engineering best practices. Requirements: 6+ years of backend software development experience. Strong hands-on experience with Golang. A minimum of 1+ year of practical Golang experience is mandatory. Strong experience with system design and distributed systems. Strong understanding of relational databases and NoSQL databases. Experience building REST and/or GraphQL APIs. Experience with microservices and event-driven architecture. Experience with queues, messaging systems, or asynchronous processing. Good understanding of scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Java Candidates: Strong Java backend engineers can also be considered only if they have at least 1 year of hands-on Golang experience. Candidates with less than 1 year of Go experience will not be considered. The selected candidate should be comfortable working primarily with Golang. Nice to Have: Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or transaction-heavy systems. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates. Experience building highly available and fault-tolerant systems. Experience working with financial transactions, payment workflows, or money movement systems.

ai_summary.why: Strong Java background with 2 years of production experience, proven expertise in event-driven systems, microservices, and high-performance databases.

Working alongside experienced software engineers and circuit designers across Arm's global engineering sites, you will learn established development practices while contributing practical solutions for engineering teams. Write clear, maintainable code in Java or Python, with supporting automation in Tcl, Bash, or tcsh. Work with circuit designers and software engineers to understand requirements and implement practical solutions. Help integrate new build methodologies and EDA tools into Custom Cells workflows. Support efficient, scalable, and parallel execution of EDA workloads in on-premises and cloud environments. Write unit, integration, and regression tests, investigate failures, and debug software issues. Participate in code reviews, document changes, and provide support to engineering users. Essential Skills and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Science, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related technical field. AUTHORITY Recommend changes to process drawings, manufacturing sequences, and process controls. COMPETENCY Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Technical Competencies: Understanding of GD&T, engineering drawings, and dimensional tolerances. Knowledge of machining processes and manufacturing process planning. Ability to prepare and maintain MD, PD, CP, and PFMEA. Working knowledge of AutoCAD or relevant engineering drawing software. Understanding of process risk assessment, quality controls, and document revision management. Behavioural Competencies: Analytical thinking and attention to detail. Problem-solving and continuous improvement. Effective communication and cross-functional coordination. PERFORMANCE MEASURES Timely preparation and release of process documents. Accuracy and completeness of drawings and documentation. Consistency between PFMEA, control plans, and process drawings. Timely implementation of engineering changes and risk mitigation actions. Reduction in documentation errors and related audit observations.
